programs.title: The Truth About Improving Your Mental Health
programs.desc: 25% of the population suffers from mental health problems, and living during the pandemic has additionally increased our stress levels.A team of scientists from Imperial College London, together with the BBC, conducted research on the mental condition of over 350,000 people in Great Britain.It turned out that comparing the results of the mental state of those before and during the pandemic may shock some people.Clinical psychologist Professor Tanya Byron and former footballer Alex Scott, who suffers from depression, will examine how the latest scientific achievements can be used to improve mental health.
